decision: The original C AC leaf passes this bounded memory/undefined-behaviour diagnostic slice; performance acceptance remains blocked separately. No production change.
coverage: Eight independently generated valid canonical tables: short codes, mixed short/long codes, lengths 1 through 16, and 255/256-value table boundaries; all-ones code left unused.
Categories 0 through 15, EOB, ZRL, zero-category unusual runs, nonzero runs and run overflow through generated symbols.
Independent code/magnitude interval expansion builds lookups; known-output streams use a canonical encoder, not a second implementation of the decoder.
8320 known-output cases span four short/long tables, 16 categories, both signs and every initial available count 0 through 64.
88920 small-boundary cases exhaust counts 0 through 17, every offset 0 through count, all 65 available counts and eight tables.

1048576 fixed-seed random cases use lengths 0 through 512, bounded offsets, all available counts, eight input alignments and eight byte patterns (random, FF-free, stuffed FF00, markers, all FF, zero, alternating and FF-at-word-boundary).
Exact logical input tails and before/after output guards are ASan-poisoned. Output canaries, AC coefficient ranges, DC zero, published offset monotonicity and bit counts are checked.
12 invalid-argument cases verify rejection leaves state and output unchanged. Fixed storage is used throughout the harness and leaf.
limits: This is a macOS ARM64 Swift 6.4/Apple Clang diagnostic, not Linux/Intel/platform qualification.
No TSan, full suite, new external oracle, allocation benchmark or timing/RSS qualification was run in this task.
Synthetic buffered-bit states exercise the stated internal bounds, including combinations not reached by normal public decoding.
The generated tables and lookups obey the leaf caller contract; arbitrary corrupt metadata is not a supported leaf input.
No findings in this bounded corpus are not a proof that every possible input is defect-free.
C-row/DC extensions are separate source revisions and are not qualified by this original-leaf receipt.
